title_en: Come out, love, to the window
en_note: Machine translation by Claude (my reading), not on Pesna.org and not checked by a native speaker. Treat it as a study aid.
translator_notes: 'Лудо' is an endearment here (crazy one/darling); 'ќ'' in 'ќ' одам' is a contraction of 'ќе'. Last line is my reading: 'земја скрила' as 'the earth has hidden'.

lines.en: Come out, love, to the window

lines.cyr: да ти видам, либе, бело лице.
lines.lat: da ti vidam, libe, belo lice.
lines.en: so I can see, love, your white face.

lines.cyr: Да ми дадеш, либе, една слика
lines.lat: Da mi dadeš, libe, edna slika

lines.en: as a keepsake, dear love, of our love.

lines.cyr: Кога ќ' одам, либе, во туѓина
lines.lat: Koga ḱ' odam, libe, vo tuǵina
lines.en: When I go, love, to a foreign land

lines.cyr: да ја гледам, либе, ем да плачам.
lines.lat: da ja gledam, libe, em da plačam.
lines.en: I will look at it, love, and also weep.

lines.cyr: Ќе ти дадам, лудо, китка цвеќе
lines.lat: Ḱe ti dadam, ludo, kitka cveḱe
lines.en: I will give you, my crazy one, a bunch of flowers

lines.cyr: да ја носиш, лудо, на туѓина.
lines.lat: da ja nosiš, ludo, na tuǵina.
lines.en: to carry, my crazy one, to the foreign land.

lines.cyr: Да ја носиш, лудо, на туѓина,
lines.lat: Da ja nosiš, ludo, na tuǵina,
lines.en: To carry it, my crazy one, to the foreign land,

lines.cyr: да ја чуваш лудо, три години.
lines.lat: da ja čuvaš ludo, tri godini.
lines.en: to keep it, my crazy one, for three years.
When the bunch of flowers, my crazy one, wilts,
the white face, my crazy one, will have darkened.
The black eyes, my crazy one, will have sunk in,
the long hair, my crazy one, the earth will have hidden.
